review.author: Codex /root

stages.S1: p. 1: Aishatu opens her box toy shop; the mixed tray has 3 leaf tickets and 5 top counters to tidy for a shared game. The practical problem requires sorting and comparison.
stages.S2: p. 1 subtitle: We will sort things, match them and put small sets in order. The child-friendly goal covers the chapter objective and retained ordering.
stages.S3: pp. 2-4: Mr Aliyu sorts the same 3 leaves/5 tops by type; draws 2 matching lines for 2 versus 4 tops and circles the larger set; counts and orders dot sets 2, 3, 4 before independent ordering.
stages.S4: p. 2: Grace repairs her sorting error; a circled leaf models selection before pupils identify the other leaf/tops and tell the rule. p. 3: Adamu predicts by spacing; pupils match equal rows of 3 and explain that every object has a partner.
stages.S5: pp. 4-6: P1-02-Q1 through Q5 require independent ordering 4,1,3; drawing 1 and 3 dots; comparing 2/5 tops and 4/3 leaves; making 5 objects. Generous boxes or a reachable table provide response space.
stages.S6: p. 6: P1-02-Q6 asks pupils to recall and show/tell how to compare their own two sets before looking back or receiving support; drawing space and manipulatives permit explanation.
stages.S7: p. 6: smaller-step 2-versus-3 dot matching includes one given pair, then returns to the pupil's own sets. p. 8: targeted interventions and a fresh 1-versus-2 recheck with explicit 2 more/1 fewer answer.
stages.S8: p. 7: the original 3 leaves/5 tops become 3 matched pairs and 2 spare tops; children identify more, put the unmatched tops in a real spare box, and take fair turns. pp. 8-9 require the same inventory and putting spares away before reading the closure.
stages.S9: p. 7: independent fresh selection of leaves at positions 2 and 4, then comparing 4 tops with 5 leaves. p. 8: another-day recall, sort/compare 4 leaves and 2 tops, order 5,2,3; complete answers and observation categories supplied.

pedagogy.evidence: Reviewed all nine pages against S1-S9. Counting to 5 from Chapter 1 is explicit on p. 8. Type sorting precedes correspondence, equal-row spacing challenges an error, ordering uses counted quantities before numerals, recall precedes support, and fresh/delayed checks differ from models. All stages above are enacted.

mathematics.evidence: Independently solved every source ID and added example against canonical data, diagrams and pp. 8-9 answers: Q1=1,3,4; Q2=1 dot left/3 right; Q3=right set of 5 tops; Q4=right set of 3 leaves; Q5=exactly 5 objects; Q6=count both or pair one to one (valid demonstrations accepted). Opening/sorted inventory=3 leaves/5 tops. Guided sort=positions 2/4 leaves, 1/3 tops; position 2 already circled. Model=2 pairs/2 unmatched in 4, so 4 more/2 fewer. Equal rows=3 each; any bijection valid. Order model=2,3,4. Support=2 pairs/1 unmatched in lower 3; either free lower partner is valid. Ending=3 pairs/2 spare tops. Fresh sort=positions 2/4; fresh comparison=5 leaves more than 4 tops. Adult 1/2 recheck=2 more/1 fewer; delayed 4 leaves/2 tops=leaves more/tops fewer, ordering=2,3,5. All quantities are code-drawn vector objects, not inferred from portraits.

instructions.evidence: Read every pupil instruction and adult answer. Tasks specify pointing, speaking, circling a whole set, line matching to different partners, writing in boxes or making objects on the table. Individual-leaf circle and whole-set circle are modelled on pp. 2-3. Pupil task numbering is absent. Read-aloud support and Chapter 1 numeral/counting prerequisite are explicit. Corrected p. 9 now identifies second/fourth object positions unambiguously.

consistency.evidence: Mr Aliyu is the sole lead, matching the P1-02 alternating assignment, and is shown in cream native clothing and embroidered cap. Inspected p. 1 all four portraits and repeated portraits pp. 2-5 against characters.json: Aishatu mustard hijab/teal dress, Adamu blue/clay, Grace clay/green with all-back plaits, John smooth scalp/green/ochre/blue manual wheelchair. Grace retries; Adamu tests a spacing guess and shares turns; Aishatu practises pausing; John requests thinking time and then compares. All six stable source IDs and answer meanings retained. Full introductions are not repeated.

logic.evidence: Tracked mixed p. 1 inventory through p. 2 sorted sets to p. 7 ending: always 3 leaves and 5 tops, giving 3 tickets/counters and 2 spares. p. 9 explicitly requires physical removal of those two spares before closure. Other quantities are separate practice examples. Every question is answerable; the 3/3 spacing trap is resolved by matching with teacher guidance, and fresh tasks have no supplied answer marks.

layout.evidence: Visually inspected EVERY rendered page 1-9, including all diagrams and portraits; reinspected rebuilt pp. 8-9 after two adult-guide corrections. Independently confirmed all nine PNGs byte-match in-memory 1.2x rasterisation of the final PDF and all pages measure 595.28 x 841.89 pt (A4). White backgrounds, dark legible text, full-colour artwork, generous drawing/number/matching areas, clear reading order and no clipping/overlap observed. Adult guide text fits. Embedded-font/bounds/vector-count validation passed.

teacher_support.evidence: pp. 8-9 supply read-aloud/prerequisite guidance, reachable large supervised manipulatives, type/colour and row-length misconceptions, count-once and one-partner support, fresh 1/2 recheck with corrected explicit answer, delayed 4/2 and 5,2,3 checks, complete six-ID and extra-task answer map, vocabulary, provenance and honest pending curriculum/educator/pupil/print/printer limits. Full-volume glossary/mapping/credits/Book 2 preview/four AI pages remain a separate legacy-volume context, not approval of other chapters.

variations: Toy-shop table/manipulative setting uses existing character portraits rather than a classroom panorama; the classroom-facing-board condition is therefore inapplicable. Reachable seated participation is explicit in adult guidance.
Seven pupil pages and two adult pages combine/repeat learning stages. No full character or teacher introductions are repeated.

S8 closure is physically enacted with the same real pieces and spare box; the write-in matching diagram shows how two spare tops are identified, and adult guidance delays closing dialogue until those pieces are away.
